messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager — billing-metering HIGH (INC-8732) — token-count drift detected in eu1. Possible customer overage flags. Runbook: /runbooks/billing-token-drift | Priority: P2
alyssa (sre): acked. I'm joining now, grabbing dashboards.
raj (oncall): I'm on pager, watching grafana <https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/db/metering?orgId=1&var-region=eu1>. seeing a sharp jump at ~2025-04-12T01:02Z.
zoe (eng): quick note — emitter-replay queue had a retry storm; ingress lag spiked. suspect duplicate emission path.
ian (billing): heads-up: automated overage alerts are firing. customer alerts pipeline shows ~47 distinct customers so far.
sam (prod-ops): can we temporarily mute overage alerts? i can flip suppression for alerts:billing_overage_eu1 for 1h.
alyssa (sre): yes please mute, sam. set retention to 1h and note in incident.
sam (prod-ops): done — muted alert rule (suppression_id=sup-4821), will notify when restored.
raj (oncall): attached quick logs from emitter service:
```
2025-04-12T01:01:58Z emitter-01 ERROR retrying message id=abcd1234 attempt=6
2025-04-12T01:02:01Z emitter-02 WARN duplicate-detected key=usr:789
```
zoe (eng): thanks. rolling a hotfix to the aggregator that dedupes by message fingerprint (v2.1.3-hotfix). deploying to eu1 canary now.
alyssa (sre): deploying safe canary on 2 nodes, monitoring token ingestion rate and consumer lag.
ian (billing): can we suppress any billing-side alerts that would notify customers? we want to avoid false overages.
raj (oncall): agreed — sam already muted the high-level overage alert. i'll also set manual throttling for recon jobs to reduce duplicate replay throughput.
sam (prod-ops): toggled featureflag ENABLE_EMITTER_REPLAY=false in eu1. patched feature flag at 01:12Z.
zoe (eng): canary looks good so far — duplicate ratio down ~78% on canary hosts. promoting to all eu1 hosts in 3 mins.
alyssa (sre): after promoting, will run a quick reconciliation pass to ensure counters are stable. starting reconcile job (job-id rc-2025-04-12-01).
liz (cs): heads-up — CS has an initial note draft if needed. if more than 50 customers were alerted we'll trigger outreach.
ian (billing): current estimate after mute: 49 total received an overage flag already. sending list to CS in a minute.
sam (prod-ops): full rollout complete at 01:18Z. emitter-replay paused, aggregator dedupe active.
zoe (eng): reconcile results: counters have plateaued; delta rate back within expected bounds after ~6 minutes.
alyssa (sre): monitoring for 30m. no new spikes. setting incident to "mitigated" but keeping page open for verification.
incident-bot: Incident INC-8732 status updated -> MITIGATED (runbook step 4). Timeline and actions recorded in /incidents/INC-8732.
liz (cs): i have customer list (49) and draft comms. recommend targeted message explaining false-positive overages and that charges will be reversed where applicable.
ian (billing): will prepare refund batch and a reconciliation note for accounting.
raj (oncall): handing off to eng-ops for post-incident follow-up. i'll update oncall log. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
alyssa (sre): quick follow-ups: 1) add extra dedupe test to CI, 2) increase alerting buffer for silent duplicate bursts, 3) postmortem with RCA scheduled.
zoe (eng): creating PR for improved fingerprinting and circuit-breaker for emitter retries. link when ready.
incident-bot: auto-check-in scheduled in 30m. If metrics regress, page will reopen.
